people_ops_anna: Quick follow-up from pricing Q&A \u2014 drop short questions about quotas, rate limits, credits here and leadership will chime in.

eng_lee: Do rate limits apply per API key or per project? We share keys in staging.

cto_jen: Defaults are project-scoped. Per-key limits map to the project the key belongs to. For org-wide controls we can layer org quotas for enterprise customers.

eng_lee: Got it. Is there an easy API call to fetch current quota/usage programmatically?

cto_jen: Yep, use the usage endpoint. Example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/projects/PROJECT_ID/current
```

cfo_maria: Trial credits expire 90 days after issuance. Promo credits show expiration in Billing -> Credits and in the redemption email.

product_maya: On packaging: we're simplifying the small tiers into a single Developer SKU next quarter; existing customers are grandfathered for 6 months. We'll announce specifics in Console and email.

eng_lee: If a job causes 429s in CI is there recommended backoff?

cto_jen: Use exponential backoff + jitter and respect Retry-After header. SDKs have helpers for this. For heavy workloads use a dedicated project or request quota increases.

support_bot: [alert] Promo credits expiring soon will show a Console banner. Billing tickets accepted via Support -> Billing.

people_ops_anna: Thanks all \u2014 will pin the FAQ once Product posts it and keep this thread open for 30m.
